# Guillaume Marty

> AI architect based in La Rochelle, France. Background: BSc in Network and Telecommunications Administration (m2i, Paris); Mac Support Technician, AppleCare, at Apple, Cork (01/2019 to 07/2023); Systems and Network Administrator at Sanofi via Computacenter (10/2023 to 09/2025). Builds AI systems and code-analysis tools in Python.

## Main project

- [GitHub Security Researcher (GSR)](https://github.com/LemonCondor/github-security-researcher): open-source tool (Python, Apache-2.0) he designed to find bugs in open-source code. Static detectors for Go (tree-sitter), reproduction of every bug with a failing test, regression tests, deterministic decision engine (LLM analysis alone can never confirm a finding), more than 500 automated tests.

## Open-source contributions (statuses checked on 2026-10-12)

Functional and robustness bugs found, reproduced and fixed, mostly with GSR:

- Kubernetes git-sync: [PR #1006](https://github.com/kubernetes/git-sync/pull/1006), merged.
- Google gVisor: [PR #15632](https://github.com/google/gvisor/pull/15632), approved by a maintainer.
- Canonical LXD: [PR #19250](https://github.com/canonical/lxd/pull/19250), approved by a maintainer.
- NASA PO.DAAC l2ss-py: [issue #464](https://github.com/podaac/l2ss-py/issues/464) and [PR #465](https://github.com/podaac/l2ss-py/pull/465), open.
- NASA harmony-py: [PR #155](https://github.com/nasa/harmony-py/pull/155), open.
- data.gouv.fr (udata): [issue #4006](https://github.com/opendatateam/udata/issues/4006) and [PR #4007](https://github.com/opendatateam/udata/pull/4007), open.
- Kubernetes kube-state-metrics [#3143](https://github.com/kubernetes/kube-state-metrics/pull/3143), Prometheus node_exporter [#3848](https://github.com/prometheus/node_exporter/pull/3848), procfs [#880](https://github.com/prometheus/procfs/pull/880), mysqld_exporter [#1095](https://github.com/prometheus/mysqld_exporter/pull/1095), Google cAdvisor [#3947](https://github.com/google/cadvisor/pull/3947): open.
- NASA F´ (fprime-tools): [issue #6176](https://github.com/nasa/fprime/issues/6176) and [PR #356](https://github.com/nasa/fprime-tools/pull/356), closed by the maintainers (experimental feature, not prioritised).

## Article (French)

- [J'ai construit un outil qui trouve des bugs dans Kubernetes, gVisor et les outils de la NASA](https://lemoncondor.github.io/guillaume-marty/article-gsr.html): how GSR works, three bugs in detail and lessons learned.
